description: This Go source file implements a store for managing shared channels, including CRUD operations, remote management, user synchronization, and attachment handling within the Mattermost platform.

classes.name: SqlSharedChannelStore
classes.description: A store for managing shared channels, including CRUD, remote, user, and attachment operations.

methods.name: Save
methods.description: Inserts a new shared channel record into the database.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Fetches a shared channel by its channel ID.

methods.name: HasChannel
methods.description: Checks if a channel ID corresponds to a shared channel.

methods.name: GetAll
methods.description: Retrieves a paginated list of shared channels based on filter options.

methods.name: GetAllCount
methods.description: Counts shared channels matching filter options.

methods.name: Update
methods.description: Updates an existing shared channel record.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Deletes a shared channel and associated remotes, unsetting the shared flag.

methods.name: SaveRemote
methods.description: Inserts a new shared channel remote record.

methods.name: UpdateRemote
methods.description: Updates an existing shared channel remote record.

methods.name: GetRemote
methods.description: Fetches a shared channel remote by ID.

methods.name: GetRemoteByIds
methods.description: Fetches a shared channel remote by channel ID and remote cluster ID.

methods.name: GetRemotes
methods.description: Retrieves shared channel remotes with filtering and pagination.

methods.name: HasRemote
methods.description: Checks if a remote exists for given channel and remote IDs.

methods.name: GetRemoteForUser
methods.description: Returns a remote cluster for a user if they belong to a shared channel with that remote.

methods.name: UpdateRemoteCursor
methods.description: Updates the cursor for a remote shared channel.

methods.name: DeleteRemote
methods.description: Deletes a shared channel remote by ID.

methods.name: GetRemotesStatus
methods.description: Returns status info for each remote invited to a shared channel.

methods.name: SaveUser
methods.description: Inserts a shared channel user record.

methods.name: GetSingleUser
methods.description: Fetches a shared channel user by user ID, channel ID, and remote ID.

methods.name: GetUsersForUser
methods.description: Retrieves all shared channel users for a specific user.

methods.name: GetUsersForSync
methods.description: Fetches shared channel users needing synchronization based on last sync timestamps.

methods.name: UpdateUserLastSyncAt
methods.description: Updates the LastSyncAt timestamp for a shared channel user.

methods.name: UpdateUserLastMembershipSyncAt
methods.description: Updates the LastMembershipSyncAt timestamp for a shared channel user.

methods.name: SaveAttachment
methods.description: Inserts a shared channel file attachment record.

methods.name: UpsertAttachment
methods.description: Inserts or updates a shared channel file attachment record.

methods.name: GetAttachment
methods.description: Fetches a shared channel file attachment by file ID and remote ID.

methods.name: UpdateAttachmentLastSyncAt
methods.description: Updates the LastSyncAt timestamp for a shared channel attachment.
